newsitem.title: USA: Illinois Senate seat remains in Democratic hands.
newsitem.headline: Illinois Senate seat remains in Democratic hands.

text.p: Democratic Rep. Richard Durbin won election to the Senate from Illionis over millionaire Republican lawyer Al Salvi, keeping the state in Democratic hands, television networks projected Tuesday.

Durbin will replace Democratic Sen. Paul Simon who retired at the end of this term. Voters had a clear ideological choice between Durbin, a moderate liberal, and Salvi, a stauch conservative. Democrats needed to hold this seat if they were to have hope of recapturing the Senate which Republicans have controlled since the 1994 election.
